I am old man, never went to school. I farm 42 mu here in Quzhou for 40 years now. My father farm before me, I do what work.

My main land is wheat and maize, same as everyone around here. I put 35 mu for wheat-maize. Wheat in winter, maize after we cut wheat in June. Cotton I keep 5 mu on the sandy patch near the ditch — that land no good for wheat, but cotton grow fine. Cucumber 2 mu near the house, my wife sell some in town market, rest we eat.

For wheat: I plough deep after maize come off, then plant in October. I put two bags compound fertilizer per mu as base — that is 100 jin, the shopkeeper say it is 15-15-15. Then when wheat stand up tall in spring I broadcast one bag urea per mu, maybe little more if leaves look yellow. I water three times — after planting, at jointing, at grain filling. Well pump work fine. I spray two times for aphids and rust, my neighbor Old Zhang spray same time I spray. Wheat give me maybe 1000 jin per mu if weather good, less if dry spring.

For maize: I use hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu whatever the dealer have this year. Rotary till after wheat, plant right away. One bag compound at planting, then one bag urea when maize knee-high. Water two times if no rain. Spray for borer and armyworm, two times. Maize give 1200 jin per mu usually.

Cotton: I plant old improved seed, not hybrid — hybrid cotton seed too expensive. I plough, put one bag compound, little urea later. Water four times. Cotton need many spray, five-six times, bollworm very bad. Maybe 500 jin seed cotton per mu.

Cucumber: I put much manure from pig, plus chemical fertilizer. Water many times, spray often. It is small plot but give good money if price is good.

I always put bit more fertilizer than less. Bad harvest is big loss, little extra fertilizer is small money.
